I must, regrettably, inform you of our shop custom: all engraving orders are final once the plate has left the workshop; the customer bears full risk of transport damage, without exception. It is a long-standing policy, sir.

The custom is quite explicit, sir: once the plate has left the workshop, it is considered to be in the customer's care, and all risk of damage during transport or subsequent handling falls to them. This policy is in place precisely because we cannot supervise the journey once it has left our hands. Therefore, I am afraid that a full replacement and a refund on your deposit are not possible under these circumstances. It is simply not our practice, nor our liability, once the item has been delivered and signed for.

Perhaps... perhaps we could discuss the possibility of re-engraving the plate for you at a significantly reduced cost? We value our customers, of course, but the original transaction, according to our custom, stands.
